description: We are a team of curious minds driven by creativity, scientific thinking, and a passion for exploring the unknown. We believe in teamwork, sharing ideas, learning from each other, and turning innovative thoughts into meaningful solutions. We welcome passionate individuals who are enthusiastic about space, science, technology, research, and problem-solving.
summary:
**Voyager 1 — The Making of a Legend** is an interactive educational experience that takes users into the world of NASA’s historic Voyager 1 mission. Set in a 1977-inspired mission environment, our project allows users to explore the spacecraft’s development journey, understand engineering roles, investigate spacecraft components, and participate in interactive technical activities.

The platform combines storytelling, engineering exploration, and hands-on learning to explain how different components and engineering contributions come together to build a spacecraft. Users can experience the process of spacecraft development rather than simply reading about it.

Our project aims to make space science more engaging and accessible, encourage curiosity about space exploration, and help users understand the technology and teamwork behind one of humanity’s most remarkable space missions.
details:
Voyager 1 — The Making of a Legend is an interactive web-based educational simulation that recreates a 1977-inspired spacecraft development environment. It allows users to explore the Voyager 1 mission through an engaging, mission-oriented experience.

Users can explore the mission, learn about engineering roles and spacecraft components, and interact with different development activities. The project connects space science, engineering concepts, technology, and storytelling to help users understand how a historic spacecraft was developed.

The experience is designed to make complex space-related concepts more accessible through interactive exploration rather than traditional reading alone. Its intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space exploration, engineering, and scientific innovation, especially among students and young learners.

The website was developed using Vite, Vanilla JavaScript, and Three.js, and is hosted publicly through GitHub Pages. The development process also involved AI-assisted tools for support and productivity.

The creative approach is to let users experience the spacecraft development journey from an engineering perspective, making the history and technology behind Voyager 1 more engaging and understandable.
